text:
evan: Quick check — proposing a safety gate before extracting the domain contract surface. We saw regressions in last canary; want a minimal set of checks pre-cutover. Idea: require contract-compat tests + perf smoke + telemetry sanity. Thoughts?

jia: +1. Also add an explicit header-shape compatibility check. In the spike we saw the `x-session-meta` shape change and downstream failed silently.

matt: Agree. For perf smoke we should validate p99 <120ms on Dedicated run and confirm batching doesn't regress. Can we automate that in CI? :gear:

oliver: We can reuse the canary harness but note model-profile-registry pulls an auth token format that changed in the last split — we'll need a shim or adapter.

lina: Proposal: ship a tiny `contract-shim` in the facade layer for 2 sprints. Keeps runtime stable and gives teams time to align. Low-risk and reversible.

sara: Quick question: do we gate on full telemetry or a small signal set? My vote: start with traces + token-cost counters, not full logs.

evan: Good call — traces + counters to start. Also add a degenerate load check to ensure KV-caching behavior and batching heuristics don't regress under small prefixes.

matt: I'll draft a CI workflow `arch/contract-gates.yml` with steps: unit -> contract-compat -> perf-smoke -> telemetry-check. Will try to have a PR by EOD.

infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary-run-178555 initiated by matt at 1785556680

jia: If the canary passes we should still keep an explicit rollback plan that doesn't touch routing tables: keep old facade binary alive and toggle via feature-flag for 24h.

evan: Agreed. Action items: matt add CI job + failure alerts, lina sketch shim and compatibility adapter, jia define header contract + tests, sara define telemetry signals and thresholds. Sync tomorrow 10:00am.

oliver: I'll add a short doc in `arch/compatibility` describing the shim pattern and the expected lifecycle. :book:
